description: This PHP class defines an API endpoint for validating the uniqueness of a project activity within a timesheet in the OrangeHRM system. It handles GET requests to check for duplicate entries based on provided timesheet, project, and activity IDs.

classes.name: TimesheetProjectActivityUniqueValidationAPI
classes.description: Defines an API endpoint class for validating the uniqueness of project activities within a specific timesheet, ensuring no duplicate entries are made for the same activity and project within a timesheet.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to validate if a project activity is a duplicate within a particular timesheet by checking against existing entries.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the GET request parameters, ensuring timesheetId, projectId, and activityId are positive integers.
